eda_toolchain_versions.yosys_slang: OSS CAD Suite 2026-10-30 Yosys + Slang SystemVerilog plugin (/opt/siliconbench/tools/oss-cad-suite/bin/yosys -m slang)

pdks.ihp_sg13g2: IHP SG13G2 130nm CMOS 3-Corner (SS/TT/FF) Open PDK + 7-Metal Hard-SRAM Macros

nangate45_45nm_shared.description: Uses the shared NanGate45 45nm Open Cell Library pre-installed at /opt/siliconbench/pdk/Nangate45 (and bundled in environments/pdk/Nangate45/).

nangate45_plus_multicorner_lib.description: Uses shared NanGate45 for logic synthesis plus task-specific fast/slow/scan corner Liberty (.lib) and SDC constraints bundled in environment/public/ and tests/private/.

ihp_sg13g2_130nm_8sram.description: Uses task-bundled IHP SG13G2 130nm 3-corner Open PDK standard-cell LEF/Liberty and hard-SRAM macro LEF/Liberty/Verilog models in environment/public/pdk/ and tests/private/pdk/.

custom_multicorner_liberty.description: Uses task-bundled characterized multi-corner Liberty (.lib) and timing scripts in environment/public/ and tests/private/.

rtl_dual_sim_standard.description: Uses standard Verilator + Icarus Verilog dual-simulator scoreboard and Yosys+Slang lint/latch/gate-level checks from the unified base image.
